distinguishing_features: Active pneumatic/hydraulic actuator cyclically preloads the flange or housing to deform the seal interface.
The mechanism physically modulates gasket contact pressure rather than passively inferring leakage from pressure-drop telemetry.
Preload pulses are synchronized with pump/flow status and chamber pressure drift.
Flange slots or external clamping hardware enable elastic deformation of the seal interface.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reducing vacuum seal leakage caused by time-dependent loss of gasket contact pressure and interfacial micro-gap formation.
parsed.viable_reason: The proposal is not viable as written because contact-pressure cycling cannot suppress bulk permeation or outgassing and the claimed reset of viscoelastic relaxation is unsupported and dimensionally inconsistent.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Prior art 3 only passively infers gasket leakage from pressure-drop changes and does not teach or suggest actively deforming the flange to maintain contact pressure.
